[SWS_DM_00332] Starting of an Uds Transport Protocol implemen- tation
⌈
The DM shall call the Start (see [SWS_DM_00322]) method of the Uds
Transport Protocol implementation during startup/initialization phase, before re-
porting ApplicationState.kRunning to the execution management and after call
to Initialize has returned.
